relations.subject: bucket:couchbase-bucket
relations.evidence: Couchbase Server places a compressed copy of the document onto the _Disk Queue_ so that the document can be written to the disk; and a further copy onto the _Replication Queue_, so that the document can be written to the replica bucket.

relations.subject: bucket:couchbase-bucket

relations.subject: memory:replication-queue
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - configurableVia. Object minted at extraction layer on compression.json this batch.
relations.evidence: (The copy placed on the Replication Queue may or may not be compressed, depending on the _compression mode_ configured for the bucket.)

relations.subject: bucket:ephemeral-bucket
relations.evidence: When a new item, such as a document, is saved by an application, it is saved in memory only, if the item is contained by an _Ephemeral_ bucket; and is saved both in memory and on disk, if the item is contained by a _Couchbase_ bucket.

notable_absence.finding: This page has no outbound Markdown links at all, even though it names 'compression mode' in passing (step 3 of the new-document sequence) without linking to compression.md, and describes ejection without linking to memory.md's Ejection section - both of which storage-settings.md, its closest sibling, does link to. The six referenced step-sequence images (createDocSequence1-4, updateDocSequence1-6) are also unlinked static assets rather than cross-references.

cross_component_finding: This page's numbered save/update sequences duplicate, at a more granular step-by-step level, facts stated more tersely on memory.md and storage-settings.md (compression on disk, ejection after a period in memory, replica propagation) - a genuine content-overlap between a walkthrough-style page and two reference-style pages covering the same mechanisms from different altitudes, rather than a contradiction.
